rationale: The agent correctly verified the user using full name and zip, worked only on the authenticated user’s orders, checked order/product details with tools, and made accurate changes: updated the watch order address to the New York address from another order, modified the silicone watch to a metal white variant with the correct refund, and updated the pending air purifier to the large, HEPA, night-mode variant with the correct additional charge. The agent also correctly noted that exchanges are only for delivered orders and instead offered and executed a modification for the pending order after getting explicit confirmation. However, the agent violated policy by performing two order-changing writes without first obtaining explicit confirmation: (1) changed the shipping address for the pending watch order without asking for confirmation, and (2) modified the silicone watch to metal white without confirmation. These misses on explicit pre-write confirmation are disqualifying under the stated policy, so the conversation fails despite otherwise correct execution.
